messages:
mina-docs: Quick PR that standardizes export examples and adds a short Node SDK snippet for listing evidence exports. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/775 :wave:

ryan-compliance: Thanks. Two asks: (1) use `actor_id` in samples to match our SOC2 templates, (2) change retention wording to explicit defaults (hosted=90d).

mina-docs: Done in draft. I used `REDACTED_EVIDENCE_URI` placeholders instead of full URIs. Added a table with defaults (hosted 90d, dedicated 365d, private configurable).

leo-eng: Node snippet needs pagination example. Suggest `for await (const page of client.listExports({pageSize:50})) {}` and show safe logging of `export.id` only.

mina-docs: Updated snippet to include async iterator + note: never log raw `evidence_ref` in public docs.

tara-legal: Good. Please also change "should be encrypted" to "must be encrypted at rest and in transit" for SOC2 tone, and add a sentence about removing embedded creds from metadata.

mina-docs: Wording updated, added before/after sanitized example (one-liner). Also included a migration note to run internal sanitize tool before publishing export metadata.

deploy-bot: docs CI passed for PR #775 (link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/775/commits/abc123)

ryan-compliance: LGTM. Approving on compliance side.

mina-docs: Merged and released in patch 1.12.2. Changelog: "clarify export redaction; add SDK pagination examples" :tada:
